:::{#exm-marginal-mean-nonindep-interaction}

#### A marginal mean under an identity link with an interaction

Suppose
$\eta_0 = 0.1$, $\b_X = 0.05$, $\b_C = 0.1$ and $\b_{XC} = 0.02$,
and $\Ef{C|X=x} = 1 + 0.5 x$,
so that $\gamma_0 = 1$ and $\gamma_x = 0.5$.
The code below computes $\Ef{Y|X=2}$ by substituting $\Ef{C|X=2}$ into the model,
and from the formula of @thm-marginal-mean-nonindep-interaction:

```{r}
#| label: exm-marginal-mean-nonindep-interaction-calc
#| code-fold: show
ex_eta0 <- 0.1
ex_bX <- 0.05
ex_bC <- 0.1
ex_bXC <- 0.02
ex_g0 <- 1
ex_gx <- 0.5
ex_x <- 2
ex_ec <- ex_g0 + ex_gx * ex_x
ex_direct <- ex_eta0 + ex_bX * ex_x + ex_bC * ex_ec + ex_bXC * ex_x * ex_ec
ex_formula <- (ex_eta0 + ex_bC * ex_g0) +
  (ex_bX + ex_bC * ex_gx + ex_bXC * ex_g0) * ex_x +
  ex_bXC * ex_gx * ex_x^2
```

The direct calculation gives `r ex_direct`
and the formula gives `r ex_formula`,
so the two agree.

:::
